<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="טבת_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916328_theRebbe_715" batchId="meluket-_D7_98_D7_91_D7_AA_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916328_theRebbe_715__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section questions why miracles above nature are drawn down specifically through the revelation of the name Havayah, even though they are the primary vehicle for Divine revelation.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And one must understand,</t>
    <t s="1">for seemingly,</t>
    <t s="2">that which creations need a miracle is</t>
    <t s="3">(not only in order to save them in their time of distress and the like, but also)</t>
    <t s="4">in order that there be a revelation of G‑dliness in the world,</t>
    <t s="5">and since in miracles that are clothed in nature there is room for error that they are nature,</t>
    <t s="6">and the main matter of the revelation of G‑dliness is in miracles that are above nature,</t>
    <t s="7">behold, by His lack are included</t>
    <t s="8">(seemingly)</t>
    <t s="9">also the miracles that are above nature,</t>
    <t s="10">and nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="11">the drawing down of miracles that are above nature is specifically through the revelation of the name Havayah.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the three names—Sha-dai (meaning "I said to My world enough"), Sha-dai (meaning "My G‑dliness is sufficient for every creature"), and Havayah—correspond to the vessels, the light that relates to vessels, and the light above relation to vessels.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">ה)</t>
    <t s="1">And this will be understood by prefacing,</t>
    <t s="2">that the three matters mentioned above—the name Sha-dai, on the name that I said to My world enough,</t>
    <t s="3">the name Sha-dai, on the name that My G‑dliness is sufficient for every creature,</t>
    <t s="4">and the name Havayah—are in vessels,</t>
    <t s="5">in the light that relates to vessels,</t>
    <t s="6">and in the light that is above relation to vessels.</t>
    <t s="7">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="8">that this that the coming into being of the world is with measure and limit</t>
    <t s="9">(that I said to My world enough)</t>
    <t s="10">is because the coming into being is through the vessels.</t>
    <t s="11">For the coming into being itself</t>
    <t s="12">(the creation of yesh from ayin)</t>
    <t s="13">is from the light</t>
    <t s="14">[for although the coming into being is through the power of the Awtsmoos,</t>
    <t s="15">which alone has the power and ability to create yesh from ayin,</t>
    <t s="16">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="17">since the light is like the luminary,</t>
    <t s="18">therefore also the light has within it the power of coming into being22],</t>
    <t s="19">except that the coming into being as it is from the aspect of the light is in a manner of without limit,</t>
    <t s="20">and in order that the coming into being be with measure and limit, it is through the clothing of the light in the vessels23.</t>
    <t s="21">And this is that the name Sha-dai, "I said to My world enough," is in the vessels,</t>
    <t s="22">for the matter of limitation in the world is through the vessels that limit</t>
    <t s="23">(the spreading forth)</t>
    <t s="24">of the light.</t>
    <t s="25">And the matter of the name Sha-dai, on the name that My G‑dliness is sufficient for every creature, is in the light,</t>
    <t s="26">that the spreading forth and revelation of G‑dliness,</t>
    <t s="27">the matter of the light,</t>
    <t s="28">is enough and sufficient for every creature.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the phrase "sufficient for every creature" emphasizes that the light reaches even the lowest creations, demonstrating its infinite and unlimited nature.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="1">that the intention of "every creature" is,</t>
    <t s="2">both for the most elevated creations,</t>
    <t s="3">that the spreading forth and revelation of G‑dliness is sufficient and fills also the lack of the most elevated creations,</t>
    <t s="4">and for the most lowly creations,</t>
    <t s="5">including those that have no virtue whatsoever and are merely creatures24,</t>
    <t s="6">that the spreading forth and revelation is drawn down also into them.</t>
    <t s="7">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="8">that from the language "My G‑dliness is sufficient for every creature,"</t>
    <t s="9">it implies that the main emphasis of "sufficient for every creature" is that it is sufficient even for the most lowly creations that are merely creatures.</t>
    <t s="10">And it can be said the explanation of this,</t>
    <t s="11">that this that it is sufficient in His G‑dliness also for the most elevated creations,</t>
    <t s="12">is not so much a novelty and superiority.</t>
    <t s="13">For since even the most elevated creations are limited,</t>
    <t s="14">behold also the revelation that is sufficient and enough for the most elevated creations,</t>
    <t s="15">is a limited revelation.</t>
    <t s="16">And the main novelty and superiority is that it is sufficient in His G‑dliness also for the most lowly creations,</t>
    <t s="17">for this that the light</t>
    <t s="18">(the spreading forth and revelation of G‑dliness)</t>
    <t s="19">is drawn down also into the most lowly creations, below which there is no lower,</t>
    <t s="20">indicates that it is infinite and without limit,</t>
    <t s="21">because of which it is drawn down downward, downward without end.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
